title: Verify-phase-only verification declaration (positive fixture)
description: Positive fixture: a conforming verification declaration declaring lifecycle-conformity checks at the verify phase only. The Verify stage binding declares zero checks — the stage gate remains (the integrity gate belongs to the artifact manifest contract, artifact-manifest.md §5.1, and structural/lifecycle-conformity content at the stage is declared, not assumed), and an empty binding is a no-op gate, not an open door (§4.4). The verify phase binds a lifecycle-conformity check at the fixed contract-level position immediately before the atomic promotion (lifecycle-model.md §5.1).

checks.description: Migrations are timed relative to promotion.
